subheading: COMPLICATIONS OF CARCINOMA OF THE PROSTATE
subheading_corrected: Complications of Carcinoma of the Prostate
text:
COMPLICATIONS OF CARCINOMA OF THE PROSTATE
Complications
- Urinary retention
- Recurrent Urinary tract infection
- Obstructive uropathy
- Progressive renal failure
- Paraplegia/Paraparesis
- Pathological fractures
- Lymphoedema
